newsitem.title: USA: Multigraphics holders approve reverse split.
newsitem.headline: Multigraphics holders approve reverse split.

text.p: Multigraphics Inc said Thursday its stockholders have approved proposals to change the name of the company from AM International Inc to Multigraphics Inc and a 1-for-2-1/2 reverse stock split.

The company also said that shareholders at a meeting on Wednesday elected a new slate of directors, including Chairman of the Board Jeff Moore, Robert Anderson III, Jeffrey Benjamin, Robert Dangremond and Thomas Rooney, who is also the new president and chief executive officer.

"The new name reflects the name under which the remaining division of the company has conducted business for over 100 years. Our customers and suppliers in this business know us as "Multigraphics," and the new name simply reflects the focus on our domestic distribution and service business," Rooney said.
